_doc: Adjudicated near-duplicate pairs, read by scripts/check_duplicates.js. A pair with no ruling here BLOCKS the gate, so a new identity collision cannot land quietly. Verdicts: 'distinct' — ruled to be two different things, dropped from the report for good; 'duplicate' — confirmed one thing entered twice, kept visible as known debt until the data is merged; 'open' — seen and recorded, not yet decided. Only 'distinct' silences a pair; the other two keep it in the report without failing the build, so debt stays visible instead of rotting.
_fields: kind: instrument | tradition | room | tuning | preface. pair: the two ids, order irrelevant. verdict + note: the decision and why.

rulings.note: one Tibetan long horn entered twice — same family and class, axes agree, and tibetan_dungchen is referenced by no tradition while dung_chen is used by one. Needs a merge decision (which record survives, and whether its parts are the richer set) before either is deleted, so it is recorded rather than silently resolved.

two genuinely different instruments, so NOT a data duplicate — but both print as 'tar', which breaks the catalog-wide unique-short-label invariant and makes a recipe naming one unreadable. The fix is a label rename, not a delete; it churns the rendered recipe for the three traditions that use them, so it is left for a deliberate pass.
